result: If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure universal access to quality education and resources. Education is a powerful tool that enables people to improve their lives, contribute to society, and make informed decisions. By ensuring that everyone has equal access to quality education, we can empower individuals to break the cycle of poverty, reduce inequality, and foster a more inclusive and compassionate world. Furthermore, providing access to resources such as the internet, books, and educational materials would ensure that everyone has the opportunity to learn and grow. This change would not only benefit individuals, but also society as a whole by creating a more educated and empathetic population that is better equipped to address the challenges facing our world.
